info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Session Dialogue Management API
info.description: The Session Dialogue Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage interactions across various customer channels. This API allows for the update and enhancement of existing session dialogues, ensuring a seamless and cohesive experience for end-users. Common use cases include adjusting parameters within ongoing dialogues to better meet customer needs or resolve issues swiftly. It is primarily utilized by customer support teams and developers looking to improve user engagement and experience in banking applications.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific session dialogue identified by its resource ID. Send the required fields in the request body to modify the session dialogue information.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary data for updating a specific session dialogue identified by RES-100045. The data should conform to the defined schema to ensure successful processing of the request.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the session dialogue has been updated.
